question: Two fair 6-sided dice are rolled. What is the conditional probability that the sum is 8 given that at least one die shows an even number?
explanation: Total outcomes with at least one even die = 36 - 9 (both odd) = 27. Outcomes with sum 8: (2,6),(3,5),(4,4),(5,3),(6,2) - all 5 have at least one even die. P = 5/27.
